title: Reconditioning Parts on Returned Self-Pay PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Reconditioning Parts on Returned Self-Pay PAP Therapy Equipment

The parts a returned self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit consumes in reconditioning are booked on its return inspection at Summit Ridge list price.

## What this governs

- **Subject:** the reconditioning parts of a self-pay unit that has come back to Summit Ridge on a completed return pickup request.
- **Result:** the reconditioning parts amount booked on the unit's return inspection, in USD to the cent.
- **Where it is booked:** on the return inspection filed on the returned unit's PAP Therapy Equipment device record by the agent; the inspection then appears in the device's service history, dated the day it is filed, showing the reconditioning parts amount.

## Desk questions

**Are the parts priced at the fee schedule?** No. Reconditioning parts are booked at Summit Ridge list price.

**Is the amount written in whole dollars?** No. It is an amount in USD with two decimal places.
